attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 10
attributes.name: Bound Elemental
attributes.powers:
Bury this card to add 1d8 to your check to defeat a barrier.

Bury this card to reduce Cold, Electricity, Fire, or Ranged Combat damage dealt to you to 0. 

After playing this card, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 12 check to recharge this card instead of burying it.

If this card is in your hand, you may treat it as a monster.
